controls.title: Sanitise media before reuse or disposal
controls.statement: Select and verify a sanitisation method suited to the media, information sensitivity and intended disposition before media leaves its current control.
controls.risk: Information could be recovered from reused or discarded media and exposed to people who were never authorised to receive it.
controls.scope: Digital media and devices being reused, returned, transferred, repaired or disposed of.
controls.examine: Inspect the media register, information classification, selected sanitisation method, operator records and verification results.
controls.interview: Ask information owners and disposal staff how methods are selected and how failed or unsupported sanitisation is handled.
controls.test: Sample sanitised media and verify the recorded method was completed and checked before release or reuse.
test_steps: Select recently sanitised media across relevant types, classifications, destinations and reuse or disposal outcomes.
Compare the recorded sanitisation technique, tool version, parameters and verification with the approved method for that media and information sensitivity.
Independently inspect a sample using an appropriate read or recovery check to confirm protected information is not accessible after sanitisation.
Verify release, reuse or inventory removal occurred only after successful verification, and failed media moved to secure destruction.
controls.expected: Each sampled item has an approved disposition, a suitable completed method and recorded verification before it leaves control.

mappings.basis: Defines purge techniques intended to make recovery infeasible while preserving media for reuse.
Requires oversight of secure disposal for devices, computers and media.
Keeps the originator responsible for controlling sanitisation and approving changes to information classification.

controls.title: Destroy media that cannot be sanitised
controls.statement: Destroy media when an approved sanitisation method cannot provide adequate assurance, using controlled handling and independent authorisation where required.
controls.risk: Sensitive information could remain recoverable if damaged, obsolete or specialised media is discarded without effective destruction.
controls.scope: Media that cannot be sanitised, failed sanitisation attempts and destruction services.
controls.examine: Review destruction decisions, authorisations, chain-of-custody records, certificates and reconciliation with the media register.
controls.interview: Ask media custodians how they decide that sanitisation is not possible and how destruction is witnessed and reconciled.
controls.test: Trace sampled media from decision through secure storage, transport, destruction evidence and removal from inventory.
test_steps: Select media designated for destruction, including failed sanitisation, damaged devices and media handled by an external destruction provider.
Trace custody from inventory and secure holding through authorised transfer, transport, destruction method and witnessed or provider evidence.
Inspect the destroyed result or a witnessed representative process to confirm reconstruction or data recovery is impractical for the media type.
Reconcile certificates, serial numbers and dates with inventory removal and investigate missing items, duplicate certificates or unexplained custody gaps.
controls.expected: Media that cannot be safely sanitised is controlled and destroyed, with complete authorisation and custody evidence.

mappings.basis: Requires destruction of equipment when it cannot be sanitised.
Requires dual authorisation for sanitisation operations on specified media; verify the organisation-defined scope.
